name: PDE-Constrained Optimization
summary: Optimize parameters or control variables subject to a discretized or continuous PDE state equation.
core_idea: Minimize an objective J(u,theta) while imposing a PDE F(u,theta)=0, often via adjoint gradients.
innovation: Uses governing equations as hard state constraints rather than only soft regression penalties.
limitations: Computing reliable derivatives requires consistent discretization and state solves.

start_here.why: Systematic reference for mathematical and discrete PDE-constrained optimization.
start_here.focus: Optimality conditions, Lagrangian, adjoints, and discrete concepts.
start_here.locator: Discrete Concepts in PDE Constrained Optimization
